title: Brick buildings part of school
content: Anyone else explore a part of the school with brick buildings? I am there a lot and there is a hippy shop there with trinkets and paper supplies I find myself remembering a lot. Tall lady with long light blue garb and messy hair who wears long beads seems to be answering my questions but I never remember what I ask. I feel when I’m there I’m on a field trip of some kind and have stepped away from my group to check out the shop. Also remembering yellow flyers or pamphlets…either in my hand or taped to the wall or being distributed… Often looking for my pets. My cats especially.
